items.title: test(skills): pin sync fixture directory permissions
items.summary: test(skills): pin sync fixture directory permissions The permission regression inherited group-write access from the runner's umask, then expected a copied directory without that bit. Give this case's source directory explicit 0755 permissions while retaining every assertion and the product's existing permission-preservation behavior. Before: 26 passed and the permission case failed under umask 0002. After: all 27 tests pass in five complete-file runs under the same umask; the full unit-src config passes 7,632 tests. Independent P2 review is clean.

items.title: fix(sessions): allow concurrent first transcript writes
items.summary: fix(sessions): allow concurrent first transcript writes A worker cold preflight could record a missing database path, then mistake another writer creating that database for source replacement. Return from cold restoration when the store is confirmed absent and leave creation to the canonical writer. Use synchronous filesystem metadata inspection to avoid adding another completion-order race before writer admission. Existing stores retain worker metadata reads, physical source checks, and caller/owner authority; transaction checks still protect cold data and writer claims. Restore the SDK locking regression removed in #162634 with an event gate and joined writers, preserving its exact ordering and single-message assertions. Give existing-store preflight fixtures the file they describe. No storage format, schema, retention, or update migration changes. The restored case fails against the original #162521 owner and passes 20 pressured whole-file runs (240 test cases). The final SDK file took 11.70 s in Vitest / 26.322 s wrapper on Linux; the new case took 390 ms.

items.title: Google發表Gemini 4 Argon，輸出上限增至100萬個Token
items.summary: Google周三（9/30）發表新一代AI模型Gemini 4 Argon，主攻複雜、長時間工作流程，輸出上限達100萬個Token，較先前Gemini模型的6.4萬個Token大幅提高。目前Argon先透過Fairwind Program提供給一批受信任的資安防禦人員測試，之後才會逐步擴大開放。

items.title: 因應PQC簽章帶來的憑證架構負擔，Cloudflare完成初步大規模MTC實測，已傳送數十億份憑證
items.summary: 由於PQC簽章體積遠大於傳統簽章，恐將增加既有憑證架構負擔，今年2月底Google與Cloudflare合作展開默克樹憑證（Merkle Tree Certificates，MTC）可行性測試，期望透過新的憑證架構與驗證機制加以改善這項問題。

items.title: Microsoft強化Entra ID登入驗證流程，阻擋外部指令碼注入
items.summary: Microsoft將自10月中旬起，強制在Entra ID瀏覽器登入流程實施強化版內容安全性原則（Content Security Policy，CSP），預計10月底前完成。在這項新政策下，僅允許來自受信任Microsoft CDN網域的指令碼執行，阻擋外部或未授權程式碼注入，以降低跨站指令碼（XSS）等攻擊竊取認證資訊的風險。

items.title: 商用逾30年C++編譯器前端EDG開源，C++ Alliance接手維護
items.summary: 老牌C/C++編譯器技術供應商Edison Design Group（EDG）正式公開C/C++編譯器前端原始碼，結束逾30年的專有授權模式。後續專案由非營利組織C++ Alliance接手維護，既有EDG開發人員也會繼續參與，原始碼目前已公開在GitHub。 EDG的C++編譯器前端自1992年推出，而編譯器前端主要負責程式碼編譯的前置工作，負責處理語法、型別和程式結構，再把分析結果交給後續的編譯或開發工具使用。因此EDG前端不像GCC或Clang主要供一般開發者直接作為編譯工具使用，而是提供給其他軟體業者整合進自家產品。

items.title: 中國駭客UAT-11587於亞洲多國政府散布後門Antino，其中包含臺灣
items.summary: 9月30日思科威脅情報團隊Talos揭露鎖定亞洲各國政府機關、參與制訂政策組織的網路間諜活動，攻擊範圍橫跨臺灣、印度、菲律賓、柬埔寨等國，其共通點是攻擊者會使用以Rust打造的後門程式Antino。相關活動最早可追蹤至2025年9月，截至今年7月，已有位於16個組織受害或是遭到鎖定，這些組織分布於包含臺灣在內的8個亞洲國家。
